_doc: Model ladder policy. A draft's confidence is computed by reconciliation, never reported by the model: start at 1.0, minus blocking_penalty per blocking issue and warning_penalty per warning. A tier's draft is accepted at or above its threshold; below it the next configured tier drafts again, and after the last tier a planner takes over. P1 work (critical finding on a high-criticality asset) needs a perfect local draft.
